documents.title: Mitigating Ghost Vectors in Dense Retrieval via Idempotent Indexing
documents.content:
Title: Mitigating Ghost Vectors in Dense Retrieval via Idempotent Indexing

Summary: Soft-deletions in vector databases leave orphaned embeddings that lead to hallucinations. This paper designs an idempotent index synchronization protocol that guarantees complete purges of outdated vector artifacts.

Authors: Duc Vu, Thao Dang

Categories: Databases, Information Systems

Published: 2026-04-18

documents.title: Freshness SLAs for Real-Time LLM Knowledge Augmentation
documents.content:
Title: Freshness SLAs for Real-Time LLM Knowledge Augmentation

Summary: We define freshness service-level agreements (SLAs) for temporal document ingestion. By tracking document age and update cadence, our orchestrator dynamically prioritizes recrawling high-churn technical corpora.

Authors: Bao Do, Linh Ngo

Categories: Data Management, Artificial Intelligence

Published: 2026-07-05

documents.content:
Title: Synthetic Corruption Testing: Stress-Testing Vector Search Robustness

Summary: We introduce an automated fuzzing suite that corrupts text chunks by injecting noise, truncating titles, and blanking summaries. Experiments reveal critical failure thresholds for dense embedding retrieval.

Authors: Kien Duong, Vy Ly

Categories: Robustness, Information Retrieval

Published: 2026-06-25

documents.title: Hybrid Search Architectures: Combining BM25 with Dense Representations
documents.content:
Title: Hybrid Search Architectures: Combining BM25 with Dense Representations

Summary: Dense vector search excels at conceptual similarity but struggles with exact acronyms and serial numbers. Reciprocal Rank Fusion of sparse lexical scores and dense embeddings achieves optimal recall.

Authors: Dat Tran, Lan Pham

Categories: Information Retrieval, Algorithms

Published: 2026-05-14

metadata.title: Hybrid Search Architectures: Combining BM25 with Dense Representations
metadata.summary: Dense vector search excels at conceptual similarity but struggles with exact acronyms and serial numbers. Reciprocal Rank Fusion of sparse lexical scores and dense embeddings achieves optimal recall.

documents.content:
Title: Continuous Benchmark Evaluation for Enterprise Retrieval Pipelines

Authors: Quang Le, Yen Vu
